question: 10 月 1 日到 7 日（含）一共有多少次有效购买？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time >= '2019-10-01' AND event_time < '2019-10-08'
tests: 时间范围过滤、有效购买口径

question: 10 月 15 日有多少个不同的用户浏览过商品？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'view' AND DATE(event_time) = '2019-10-15'

question: 10 月 16 日至 31 日的 GMV 是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price), 2) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time >= '2019-10-16' AND event_time < '2019-11-01'
tests: GMV 口径 + 时间范围

question: 10 月 20 日一共有多少次加购？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'cart' AND DATE(event_time) = '2019-10-20'

question: 有效购买中，成交价格超过 1000 的有多少次？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND price > 1000

question: 有效购买中最高的一笔成交价格是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0

question: 10 月哪一天的有效购买次数最多？（回答日期，格式 YYYY-MM-DD）
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(event_time) AS d FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 有多少个会话包含 10 次及以上的浏览？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE n_views >= 10

question: 单个会话里最多有多少次购买？（按 sessions 表的 n_purchases）
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(n_purchases) FROM sessions

question: 10 月 10 日的平均成交价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND DATE(event_time) = '2019-10-10'

question: GMV 最高的品牌是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND p.brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY SUM(e.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: GMV 最高的一级品类是哪个？（不含没有品类的商品）
gold_sql: SELECT c.level1 FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND c.level1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.level1 ORDER BY SUM(e.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: electronics 一级品类的 GMV 是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(e.price), 2) FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND c.level1 = 'electronics'

question: apple 品牌的平均成交价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.price), 2) FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND p.brand = 'apple'

question: 有多少个用户购买过 xiaomi 品牌的商品？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND p.brand = 'xiaomi'

question: 10 月哪一天的 GMV 最高？（回答日期，格式 YYYY-MM-DD）
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(event_time) AS d FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY SUM(price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 购买用户数最多的二级品类（level2）是哪个？（不含 level2 为空的）
gold_sql: SELECT c.level2 FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND c.level2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.level2 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) DESC LIMIT 1
tests: 二级品类 + 用户去重

question: 二级品类 smartphone 的 GMV 是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(e.price), 2) FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND c.level2 = 'smartphone'

question: 有效购买次数排名第三的品牌是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT brand FROM (SELECT p.brand, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND p.brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3) t ORDER BY n ASC LIMIT 1
tests: 排名第 N + 排除空品牌

question: 周末（周六、周日，按 UTC 日期）发生的有效购买，占全部有效购买次数的比例是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(DAYOFWEEK(event_time) IN (1, 7)), 4) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0

question: 一天中哪个小时（UTC，0–23）的有效购买次数最多？（只回答小时数字）
gold_sql: SELECT HOUR(event_time) AS h FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 GROUP BY h ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 有多少个不同的用户浏览过 samsung 品牌的商品？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.event_type = 'view' AND p.brand = 'samsung'

question: appliances 一级品类的用户级「浏览→购买」转化率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 THEN e.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'view' THEN e.user_id END), 4) FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.level1 = 'appliances'
tests: 默认口径（用户级、有效购买）

question: 在 10 月 1–15 日有过有效购买的用户中，有多少人在 16–31 日又有有效购买？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(event_time < '2019-10-16') > 0 AND SUM(event_time >= '2019-10-16') > 0) t
tests: 两个时间段的用户交集

question: apple 品牌的复购用户有多少个？（复购：在 2 个及以上不同会话中购买过 apple）
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT e.user_id FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND p.brand = 'apple' GROUP BY e.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_session) >= 2) t

question: 在有过加购行为的用户中，有过有效购买的用户占比是多少？（不考虑先后顺序）
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(has_buy), 4) FROM ( SELECT user_id, MAX(event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0) AS has_buy FROM events GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(event_type = 'cart') > 0) t

question: 会话级的「浏览→购买」转化率是多少？（有有效购买的会话数 ÷ 有浏览的会话数）
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 THEN user_session END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'view' THEN user_session END), 4) FROM events WHERE user_session IS NOT NULL

question: 在有效购买次数不少于 1000 次的品牌中，平均成交价最高的是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND p.brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY AVG(e.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 浏览用户数不少于 10000 的一级品类中，用户级「浏览→购买」转化率最低的是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT c.level1 FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.level1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.level1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'view' THEN e.user_id END) >= 10000 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 THEN e.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'view' THEN e.user_id END) ASC LIMIT 1
tests: 门槛 + 转化率排名 + 排除未分类

question: 成交价格最高的前 1% 的有效购买，贡献了全部 GMV 的多大比例？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= CEIL(n * 0.01) THEN price END) / SUM(price), 4) FROM ( SELECT price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0) t

question: 浏览到购买转化率最高的品牌是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.brand HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'view' THEN e.user_id END) >= 1000 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 THEN e.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'view' THEN e.user_id END) DESC LIMIT 1
tests: 陷阱：小样本品牌转化率可能是 100%，应只在浏览用户 ≥1000 的品牌中排名

question: 加购到购买的转化率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(has_buy), 4) FROM ( SELECT user_id, MAX(event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0) AS has_buy FROM events GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(event_type = 'cart') > 0) t
tests: 陷阱：购买用户数 ÷ 加购用户数会超过 100%

question: 10 月下半月（16–31 日）的复购率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(ns >= 2), 4) FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_session) AS ns FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time >= '2019-10-16' AND event_time < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY user_id) t
tests: 陷阱：复购按会话定义，而不是按购买次数

question: 10 月第一周（1–7 日）的客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 2) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time < '2019-10-08'
tests: 陷阱：没有订单，客单价按人均消费计算

question: 全站 10 月的 GMV 大约是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price) * 10, 2) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time < '2019-11-01'
tests: 陷阱：数据是 1/10 抽样，问全站要乘 10

question: 10 月 1–15 日的整体转化率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 THEN user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'view' THEN user_id END), 4) FROM events WHERE event_time < '2019-10-16'
tests: 陷阱：默认用户级口径，事件级会小很多

question: 购买用户数第二多的一级品类是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT c.level1 FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND c.level1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.level1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
tests: 陷阱：没有品类的商品不能当作一个品类参与排名

question: 浏览到购买转化率排名第三的一级品类是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT c.level1 FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.level1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.level1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'view' THEN e.user_id END) >= 1000 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 THEN e.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'view' THEN e.user_id END) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2
tests: 陷阱：小样本品类 + 未分类都不应参与排名

question: 最近 7 天的 GMV 是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price), 2) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time >= '2019-11-24'
tests: 陷阱：「最近」以数据最后一天为准，不能用 NOW()

question: GMV 排第四的品牌是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand FROM events e JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase' AND e.price > 0 AND p.brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY SUM(e.price) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3
tests: 陷阱：空品牌不能占一个名次

question: 10 月 1 日到 7 日一共有多少人买过东西？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time < '2019-10-08'
tests: 陷阱：问的是人数，要去重

question: 10 月成交价格最低的一笔购买是多少钱？
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(price) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase' AND price > 0 AND event_time < '2019-11-01'
tests: 陷阱：0 元购买是异常记录，要排除
